A '''Dubloviann flame rifle''' was one of the many weapons used by [[Aeona Cantor]]'s group on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Mindor/Legends|Mindor]]. They originated from the [[Dubloviann system/Legends|Dubloviann system]].<ref name="Shadows of Mindor">''[[Luke Skywalker and the Shadows of Mindor]]''</ref>
